entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex, VeloFit support ID 302. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex, I need to process a return. Order number is VF-PULSE-88142.
Okay, VF-PULSE-88142. Let me just pull that up for you. One moment... I see it's for a VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 27th. Is that right?
Yes. Listen, I know it's been about two weeks. My son had an accident and needed emergency surgery. I've been at the hospital with him non-stop.
Oh my, I'm so sorry to hear that. I hope he's recovering well. Please, don't worry about the time frame.
He's stable, but now his military deployment is all up in the air. The band was a gift for that, so it's not needed now. Can I return it or not?

Of course. I completely understand. Family and health emergencies come first. Let me just check the policy for you... Okay, yes. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within the window. No exception needed.
Oh. Ninety days? I thought it was shorter. Okay, great. So what's the next step?

It's very straightforward. I've just processed the return authorization in our system. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on file right now. You should see it in your inbox in the next minute or two.
Okay, I see it. Just print this and stick it on the box?
That's correct. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, a full refund will be issued to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
You're very welcome. My best wishes to your son for a speedy recovery. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
